description: This file defines the initMySugar function, which initializes and manages a dashboard editing and interaction interface in the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for layout management, dashlet CRUD operations, category toggling, searching, and dialog rendering, all related to the custom dashboard functionality within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ygDDList
classes.description: A custom drag-and-drop list class used in dashlet management.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the current dashboard layout as a string or array, depending on parameter.

methods.description: Handles the event when a dashlet starts being dragged.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles the event when a dashlet is dropped in a new position and saves the updated layout.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the current dashboard layout via an AJAX request.

methods.name: uncoverPage

methods.name: retrieveCurrentPage

methods.name: closeDashletsDialog
methods.description: Closes the dashlets selection dialog.

methods.name: toggleDashletCategories
methods.description: Switches visible dashlet categories and updates UI.

methods.description: Performs an AJAX search for dashlets matching input criteria.

methods.name: collapseReportList

methods.description: Resets and hides the search UI.

methods.description: Reloads the page, likely after analytics changes.

methods.name: renderDashletsDialog
methods.description: Initializes and displays the dashlets selection dialog, setting height dynamically.
